senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (राकयति)
1 To taste.
2 To obtain.

m. (-कः)
1 The sun gem.
2 Crystal.
3 A hard shower.
E.
रक to obtain, अच् aff.

f. (-का)
1 Full moon, or the day of full moon.
2 A girl in whom menstruation has commenced.
3 Scab, itch.
4 The name of a river.
E.
रा to give, (good fortune,) क Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Dyed, tinged, coloured, stained.
2 Red, of a red colour.
3 Fond of, attached to, affected with love or interest towards any object.
4 Pure, purified.
5 Sporting, engaging in play or pastime.
m. (-क्तः)
Red, the colour.
n. (-क्तं)
1 Blood.
2 Saffron.
3 Copper.
4 Minium.
5 Vermilion.
6 The fruit of the Flacourtia cataphracta.
f. (-क्ता)
1 The Gunja plant, (Abrus precatorius.)
2 Lac.
3 Bengal madder.
E.
रञ्ज to colour or dye, &c., aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant bearing a red blossom, (Pentapetes phoenicea; it is also applied to the Ixora bandhuca.)
2 Globe amaranth, (Gomphræna globosa, the red variety.)
3 Red garments or cloth.
4 A man affected with passion or fondness.
5 A gamboller, a player, one who plays or sports.
6 Safflower.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-न्दः)
1 Coral.
2 A sort of onion.
3 A kind of yam (Dioscorea purpurea?)
E.
रक्त red, and कन्द a root.

m. (-लः)
Coral.
E.
रक्त red, कन्द, and लच् aff.

n. (-लं)
The red lotus.
E.
रक्त red, and कमल the lotus.

m. (-नः)
Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)
E.
रक्त red, and काञ्चन the same.

n. (-दं)
The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra, Rox.)
E.
रक्त red, and कुमुद the lotus.

n. (-वं)
The red lotus.
E.
रक्त, and कैरव a lotus.

n. (-दं)
The red lotus.
E.
रक्त, and कोकनद a lotus.

m. (-ल्मः)
1 A disease, a hard lump in the abdomen of the female after conception, perhaps scirrhus of the ovarium.
2 A clot of blood.
E.
रक्त, and गुल्म cluster.

m. (-घ्नः)
A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.)
f. (-घ्नी)
A kind of grass, a variety of the Dūb grass.
E.
रक्त blood, and घ्न removing; anti-plethoric.

n. (-नं)
1 Red wood, either red Sandal or sappan wood.
2 Saffron.
E.
रक्त red, and चन्दन Sandal.

n. (-र्णं)
1 Red lead.
2 Any red powder.
E.
रक्त red, चूर्ण powder, dust.

m. (-कः)
An earthworm.
E.
रक्त red, and जन्तु an insect, aff. कन्.

m. (-ह्वः)
A lion.
E.
रक्त red, and जिह्वा the tongue.

m. (-ण्डः)
A parrot.
E.
रक्त red, and तुण्ड a beak.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Redness.
2 Passion, affection.
E.
त्व added to रक्त; also with तल्, रक्तता.

f. (-न्ती)
A name of PĀRVATĪ.
E.
रक्त red, दन्त a tooth, aff. ङीष्.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Red-eyed.
m. (-दृक्)
A pigeon.
E.
रक्त red, and दृश् the eye.

m. (-तुः)
1 Red chalk or red orpiment.
2 Copper.
E.
रक्त red, and धातु a mineral.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-नः)
The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.)
E.
रक्त red, and नयन the eye, red-eyed.

m. (-कः)
An owl.
E.
रक्त red, नासिका the nose.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Who or what drinks blood.
m. (-पः)
An imp, a goblin.
f. (-पा)
1 A leech.
2 A female goblin.
E.
रक्त blood, and प what drinks, from पा with क aff. and टाप् for the feminine.

m. (-क्षः)
GARUḌA.
E.
रक्त red, and पक्ष wing.

f. (-दी)
A plant, variously considered as a sort of sensitive plant or a species of Lycopodium.
E.
रक्त red, पद foot or root, aff. ङीष्.

m. (-तः)
Spilling of blood.
E.
रक्त and पात causing to fall.

f. (-ता)
A leech.
E.
रक्त blood, and पात nourished.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Red-footed.
m. (-दः)
A parrot.
E.
रक्त red, and पाद foot.

m. (-यी)
A bug.
f. (-नी)
A leech.
E.
रक्त blood, and पायिन् what drinks.

n. (-दं)
Native vermilion, cinnabar.
E.
रक्त red, and पारद quicksilver.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 The China rose, (Hibiscus rosa sinensis.)
2 A climbing plant, (Ventilago madraspatana.)
3 A spontaneous discharge of blood from the nose and mouth.
4 A red pimple or boil.
E.
रक्त red, and पिण्ड lump.

m. (-त्तः)
Plethora, spontaneous hæmorrhages from the mouth, nose, rectum and cuticle, accompanied with fever and headache, vomiting, purging, &c.
E.
रक्त red, and पित्त bile, the bile being of that colour; or रक्त blood, and पित्त bile, it being supposed to be an affection of both fluids or humors.

f. (-हा)
Variety of bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
E.
रक्तपित्त the disease, and हा what removes.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 Nerium odorum, the red variety.
2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.)
mf. (-ष्पः-ष्पा)
The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
f. (-ष्पी)
1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
2 Bryony, (Bryonia grandis.)
E.
रक्त red, and पुष्प flower, whence it may be applied to any plant bearing red blossoms.

m. (-कः)
1 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.)
3 A red flower, (Ixora bandhuca, or Pentapetes phoenicea.)
4 The silk-cotton tree.
5 The coral tree.
6 A tree from which a red dye is prepared, (Rottleria tinctorea.)
f. (-ष्पिका)
A sort of sensitive plant or species of Lycopodium.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-लः)
The Indian fig tree.
f. (-ला)
A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.)
E.
रक्त red, and फल fruit.

m. (-जः)
A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs.
E.
रक्त blood, फेन froth or phlegm, and ज born.

n. (-कं)
Red lead.
E.
रक्त red, and बालुका sand.

m. (-रः)
A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.)
E.
रक्त red, मञ्जरी a pedicle, aff. टच्.

n. (-लं)
The red lotus.
E.
रक्त red, and मण्डल a circle.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Bloody, full or consisting of blood.
E.
रक्त, and मयट् aff.

n. (-णं)
Bleeding, letting blood.
E.
रक्त, and मोक्षण loosing.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
E.
रक्त red, यष्टि a stick.

m. (-णुः)
1 Red lead.
2 The blossom of the Palāśa, (Butea frondosa.)
3 A sort of cloth.
4 An angry man.
E.
रक्त red, and रेणु dust; also with कन् added in the second meaning रक्तरेणुका.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-नः)
A pigeon.
E.
रक्त, and लोचन an eye.

f. (-टी)
Small pox.
E.
रक्त red, and वटी a pustule.

f. (-टी)
Small pox.
E.
रक्त red, वरटी a pustule.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Red, of a red colour.
m. (-र्णः)
1 An earthworm.
2 Red, (the colour.)
E.
रक्त red, and वर्ण colour.

m. (-नः)
The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
रक्त blood, and वर्द्धन increasing.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dressed in red.
m. (-नः)
The mendicant, or Brahman of the fourth order, especially as occasionally clad in red garments.
E.
रक्त red, and वसन vesture.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Conveying blood, (as an artery.)
E.
रक्त, and वाहिन् what bears.

m. (-धिः)
A sore or ulcer from a vitiated state of blood.
E.
रक्त, and विद्रधि a sore.

m. (-न्दुः)
1 A red spot forming a flaw in a gem.
2 A drop of blood.
E.
रक्त fed, and विन्दु a drop.

m. (-जः)
1 The pomegranate.
2 The name of a demon killed by DURGĀ.
E.
रक्त red, and वीज the seed.

f. (-न्ता)
A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
E.
रक्त red, and वृन्त a stalk.

m. (-लिः)
A red variety of rice, (Oriza sativa.)
E.
रक्त red, शालि rice.

n. (-नं)
Red lead.
E.
रक्त red, and साशन an edict; from the document perhaps being sealed or signed with a preparation of this substance.

m. (-वः)
1 Venesection, bleeding.
2 A kind of dock or sorrel.
E.
रक्त, and श्राव causing to flow; also रक्तश्रावणं.

n. (-चं)
Safflower.
E.
रक्त red, (a dye,) सङ्कोच a contracting.

n. (-कं)
The blue lotus.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Saffron.
E.
रक्त red or blood, and संज्ञा appellation; also similar compounds, as रक्तनामन्, रक्तनामक, &c.

n. (-कं)
The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.).
E.
रक्त red, सन्ध्या twilight, कन् aff. of comparison.

n. (-हं)
The red lotus.
E.
रक्त, and सरोरुह a lotus.

m. (-कं)
A kind of dock or sorrel.
E.
रक्त blood, &c., and सौगन्धिक a lotus.

f. (-सा)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Bloodless, cold-blooded.
E.
रक्त, and हीन devoid of.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Sprinkled with blood.
2 Dyed red.
n. (-क्तं)
Red wood, (Pterocarpus santolinus; applied also to the Cæsalpinia sappan.)
E.
रक्त, and आक्त sprinkled, spread

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Red-eyed.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A buffalo.
2 A pigeon.
3 The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.)
4 A tyrant, a savage, a barbarous or cruel man.
5 The Indian crane.
E.
रक्त red, and अक्षि the eye, aff. ष.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The planet MARS.
2 A plant, (a species of Crinum.)
3 A bug.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Coral.
2 Saffron.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)
E.
रक्त red, and अङ्ग body.

m. (-रः)
Dysentery.
E.
रक्त, and अतीसार diarrhoea.

m. (-रः)
The skin.
E.
रक्त blood, आघार receptacle.

m. (-न्थः)
Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia with sponginess of the vessels so as to discharge blood on being touched.
E.
रक्त, and अधिमन्थ ophthalmia.

m. (-न्दः)
Redness of the vessels of the eye with flow of tears.
E.
रक्त, and अभिष्यन्द flow.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dressed in red.
m. (-रः)
Any vagrant devotee, wearing red garments.
E.
रक्त red, and अम्बर vesture.

m. (-नः)
Globe amaranth, the red variety.
E.
रक्त red, and अम्लान amaranth.

m. (-लुः)
A sort of yam, (Dioscorea purpurea.)
E.
रक्त red, and आलु yam.

n. (-नं)
Letting blood, bleeding.
E.
रक्त, and अवसेचन sprinkling.

m. (-यः)
Viscus in which the blood is contained or secreted, viz. the heart, the liver, and the spleen.
E.
रक्त, and आशय receptacle.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Affection, attachment.
2 Addiction to.
E.
रञ्ज to be affected, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Abrus precatorius).
2 The seed of the Abrus precatorius used as a weight, or a fictitious weight, denominated from the seeds originally so used; the seed weighs about 1 and (5/16) troy grain, the artificial ratti or Raktikā should be double that weight, but in common use it averages nearly 2 grains and a quarter.
E.
रक्त red, कन् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Red-eyed, having the eyes inflamed or blood-shot.
E.
रक्त, and ईक्षण the eye.

n. (-लं)
The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.)
E.
रक्त red, उत्पल lotus.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Red.
m. (-भः)
Redness, red, the colour.
E.
रक्तोत्पल the red lotus, आभ resembling.

n. (-लं)
Indurated ochre, or clay iron stone.
E.
रक्त red, उपला a stone, hence applied also to red ochre, red orpiment, red chalk, &c.

r. 1st cl. (रक्षति)
To guard, to protect, to cherish, to preserve.
With परि,
To save from ruin.

mf. (-क्षः-क्षा)
1 Preserving, protecting.
2 Lac.
f. (-क्षा)
1 Ashes.
2 A sort of bracelet, a twist of thread or tinsel, with a small packet containing a few carminative seeds, bound round the wrist at particular periods, especially the day of full moon in Śrāvaṇa.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, aff. अच्.

f. (-क्षा)
Lac, the red animal dye.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, (colour,) अ aff., and the vowel made long.

n. (-भं)
A multitude or assemblage of goblins.
E.
रक्षस् a demon, and सभा assemblage.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what protects, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A guardian, a protector.
2 A watch, a guard.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Preserving, protecting, defending.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be guarded, preserved, protected, &c.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-कः)
Urinary affection, as gonorrhoea, &c. elsewhere read रक्षणारक.

mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्)
Preserving, guarding, protecting.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, शतृ aff.

n. (-क्षः)
A Rakṣas, an evil spirit, apparently distinguishable into three classes: one sort of Rakṣas is of a demi-celestial nature, and is ranked with the attendants on KUVERA; another corresponds to a goblin, an imp, or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, disturbing sacrifices, and ensnaring and devouring human beings; the third kind approaches more to the nature of the Titan, or relentless and powerful enemy of the gods.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, (KUVERA'S treasures, &c.) असुन् aff.; also राक्षम.

m. (-शः)
A contemptible Rakṣas
E.
रक्षस्, and पाश aff.

m. (-तः)
A governor, a magistrate.
E.
रक्षा, and अधिकृत set over.

m. (-कः)
1 A door-keeper or porter.
2 A guard of the women's apartments.
3 A catamite.
4 An actor, a mime.
E.
रक्ष preserving, अप before ईक्ष to see, aff. वुन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Preserved, protected, defended.
2 Kept, detained.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be guarded, protected, &c.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what protects, defends, &c., a protector, a guard.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि)
Who or what preserves or protects.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-र्गः)
A guard, a sentinel.
E.
रक्षि from रक्षिन् a preserver, and वर्ग class.

m. (-णः)
A class or troop of evil spirits.
E.
रक्षस्, and गण a troop.

m. (-घ्नः)
Marking-nut plant.
n. (-घ्नं)
1 Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice water.
2 Asafoetida.
E.
रक्षम् a goblin, and घ्न destroying, repelling.

f. (-नी)
Night.
E.
रक्षम् a sprite, and जननी mother.

m. (-क्ष्णः)
Preserving, guarding, defence, protection.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, aff. नङ्.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
To be guarded, protected, preserved, &c.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Preserved.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Infernal, demoniacal.
m. (-सः)
An evil spirit, a demon, a vampire, a fiend, but who appears to be of various descriptions, and is either a powerful Titan or enemy of the gods in a superhuman or incarnate form, as RĀVAṆA and others; an attendant on KUVERA, and guardian of his treasures; or a mischievous and cruel goblin or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, and devouring human beings.
f. (-सी)
1 A female fiend; the female of the preceding.
2 A large tooth, a tusk.
3 A sort of perfume, commonly Cor.
n. (-सं)
1 A form of marriage, the violent seizure and rape of a girl after the repulse or destruction of her relatives.
2 Surgery, cure by the knife or cautery.
E.
रक्ष to preserve, to be preserved, (from whom,) aff. असुन्, and अण् pleonasm added; or रक्षस् a demon, and अण् aff. of reference.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 The demon RĀVAṆA.
2 KUVERA.
E.
राक्षस a demon, and इन्द्र lord.
